# CanvasGroup

- Inherits [`Frame`](frame.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("CanvasGroup")`

A `Frame` whose descendants are drawn together into one image, which is then shown as a whole. Use it to fade a window as one piece, instead of having its parts show through each other. `GroupTransparency` and `GroupColor` apply to the whole image.

The image is drawn again only when something inside the group changes. A group always clips its descendants to its rectangle.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GroupColor` | `Color3` | `Color3.new(1, 1, 1)` | read/write | A color the whole image is multiplied by. White changes nothing. |
| `GroupTransparency` | `number` | `0` | read/write | How transparent the whole group is, from 0 (opaque) to 1 (invisible). |
